text.en:
1. (1) This Act may be cited as the Statistics Act 2026.

(2) This Act comes into operation on a date to be appointed

by the Minister by notification in the Gazette.

This Act binds Federal Government and State Government

2. This Act shall bind the Federal Government and

State Government.

LAWS OF MALAYSIA

Act 887

STATISTICS ACT 2026

Interpretation

3. In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires—

"data" means particulars or information in any form;

"prescribed" means prescribed by the Minister by regulations

made under this Act;

"Government entity" means—

(a) any ministry, department, office, authority or agency,

of the Federal Government or State Government, or any

other entity in the Federal Government or State Government

service;

(b) any statutory body of the Federal Government or

State Government established under any written law; or

(c) any local authority;

"head of Government entity" means any officer who is

responsible for a Government entity, including any officer

authorized in writing by the head of Government entity to act

on his behalf;

"Chief Statistician" means the Chief Statistician appointed

under subsection 4(2);

"Council" means the National Statistics Council established

under section 7;

"Minister" means the Minister charged with the responsibility

for matters relating to statistics;

"statistics" means the value or figures produced from

the process of data collection, compilation, analysis and

interpretation.
Statistics 7

Part II

DEPARTMENT OF STATISTICS MALAYSIA

Department of Statistics Malaysia and its officers

4. (1) The Department of Statistics shall be known as

the Department of Statistics Malaysia.

(2) The Yang di-Pertuan Agong shall appoint a Chief Statistician

from among officers currently serving in the federal public services

who have the following qualifications:

(a) hold a master's degree or a doctor of philosophy degree

in the field of statistics, economics, data science,

mathematics, or other fields relating to statistics, from

a university recognized by the Government of Malaysia;

(b) have at least twenty years of working experience in

the field of statistics;

(c) have knowledge, technical skills and expertise in producing

and disseminating statistics in the field of social,

economic, or other fields relating to statistics; and

(d) have knowledge, skills and experience in conducting

population, economic, agricultural and household census

or surveys at the national or state level.

(3) There shall be appointed such number of Deputy Chief

Statisticians, and such other officer of the Department of

Statistics Malaysia as may be necessary for the purpose of carrying

into effect the provisions of this Act.

(4) Every Deputy Chief Statistician and officer of

the Department of Statistics Malaysia shall be subject to

the control and directions of the Chief Statistician.

Functions of Department of Statistics Malaysia

5. (1) The functions of the Department of Statistics Malaysia are

as follows:

(a) to be a central repository for data and statistics;

(b) to collect, compile, analyse and interpret data for

the purposes of furnishing information required for

the formation or carrying out of Government policies

or otherwise required for Government purposes;

(c) to disseminate data and statistics;

(d) to develop and establish statistical standards and

procedures;

(e) to ensure the quality, integrity and reliability of official

statistics for the Government of Malaysia;

(f) to advice any Government entity or any person in matters

relating to statistics;

(g) to coordinate statistical activities for any Government

entity or any person;

(h) to provide training relating to statistics; and

(i) to perform any other functions relating to data and statistics

as may be necessary for the purposes of this Act.

(2) The Chief Statistician shall have all such powers as may

be necessary for, or in connection with, or incidental to

the performance of the functions of the Department of

Statistics Malaysia under this Act.

Delegation of powers

6. (1) The Chief Statistician may, in writing, delegate any of

his powers under this Act to any Deputy Chief Statistician or

other officer of the Department of Statistics Malaysia subject

to such conditions, limitations or restrictions as the Chief Statistician

thinks fit except the power of delegation under this section.
Statistics 9

(2) The delegation of any power under this section shall

not prevent the Chief Statistician from exercising the powers

so delegated.

Part III

NATIONAL STATISTICS COUNCIL

Establishment of National Statistics Council

8. The Council may invite any person to attend any of

its meetings to advise the Council on any matter under discussion,

but the person is not entitled to vote at the meeting.

Functions of Council

9. The functions of the Council are as follows:

(a) to act as the main advisory body for providing guidance

and directions on matters relating to statistics;

(b) to evaluate and endorse statistical standards and

procedures in Malaysia; and

(c) to do such other things arising out of or incidental to

the functions of the Council under this Act.

Meetings of Council

10. (1) The Council shall convene its meeting as often as

the Chairman may determine and the meeting shall be held

at the time and place as determined by the Chairman.

(2) The Chairman shall preside at all meetings of the Council

but if the Chairman is absent from any meeting, the members

present shall elect one from among themselves to preside

at that meeting.

(3) Seven members, including the Chairman, shall constitute

a quorum for a meeting of the Council.

(4) The Chairman may authorize the use of a live video link,

live television link or any other electronic means of communication

for the purpose of any meeting of the Council, and any member

attending the meeting through such means shall be deemed

to be present at the meeting.

(5) The Council may determine its own procedure.

Committees

11. (1) The Council may establish such committees

as the Council considers necessary or expedient to assist

the Council in the performance of its functions under this Act.

(2) The Council may appoint any person to be a member

of any committee established under subsection (1).

(3) The Council may appoint any of its members to be

the chairman of any committee established under subsection (1).
Statistics 11

(4) A member of a committee shall hold office for such term

as the Council may specify in his letter of appointment and

is eligible for reappointment.

(5) A committee shall be subject to, and act in accordance

with, any directions given by the Council.

(6) A committee shall meet as often as may be necessary at

the time and place as the chairman of the committee may determine.

(7) A committee may invite any person to attend any of

its meeting to advise the committee on any matter under discussion.

(8) A committee may determine its own procedure.

Part IV

DATA COLLECTION, PUBLICATION AND COMMUNICATION

Directions to furnish data

12. (1) The Chief Statistician may, by notice in writing, direct

any person to furnish such data within the person's knowledge

or which the person is reasonably able to obtain, in the form

and manner and within the period specified in the notice or

such extended period as the Chief Statistician may grant.

(2) A notice under subsection (1) shall be served on the person

either personally, by registered post, or by electronic means.

(3) Any person directed to furnish data under subsection (1)

shall ensure that the data furnished is true, accurate and complete,

and shall provide an express representation to that effect,

including a declaration the person is not aware of any other data

that would render the furnished data untrue or misleading.

(4) If the person directed to furnish data under subsection (1)

does not have the data, or the data is incomplete, the person shall

notify the Chief Statistician in the form and manner and within

the period as specified in the notice.

(5) Any person who contravenes subsection (3) commits

an offence and shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine

not exceeding fifty thousand ringgit and in the case of a continuing

offence, to a further fine not exceeding two thousand ringgit

for each day during which the offence continues after conviction.

Request for data

13. The Chief Statistician may request any data from

any Government entity by notice in writing directing

the head of the Government entity to furnish the data.

Publication and communication of data and statistics

14. (1) No data or statistics obtained under this Act shall be

published or communicated to any other person except in accordance

with the following requirements:

(a) the prior approval of the Chief Statistician has been

obtained;

(b) the publication or communication is made within

the period or at the time specified by the Chief Statistician;

and

(c) the publication or communication is made in such a manner

as to ensure that the identity of any person to whom

the data or statistics relates to the data and statistics

received is not disclosed.

(2) No data or statistics shall be used by any person for

the purpose of determining any liability to any form of taxation

or levy, whether Federal, State, or otherwise or be communicated

to any authority or person likely to use the data or statistics

for that purpose.

(3) Any person may request any data or statistics, or any

physical or digital publication issued, by the Department

of Statistics Malaysia, in the form and manner determined by

the Chief Statistician and upon payment of the prescribed fee.
Statistics 13

(4) Any person who contravenes subsection (1) commits

an offence and shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine

not exceeding fifty thousand ringgit.

Part V

GENERAL

Obligation of secrecy

15. (1) Except for the purposes of this Act or for the purposes

of any civil or criminal proceedings under any written law,

a n y D e p u t y C h i e f S t a t i s t i c i a n o r o t h e r o ff i c e r o f

the Department of Statistics Malaysia, during or after his tenure

of office or employment, shall not disclose any data and statistics

obtained by him in the course of his duties.

(2) Any person who contravenes subsection (1) commits

an offence and shall, on conviction, be liable to a fine

not exceeding ten thousand ringgit or to imprisonment for

a term not exceeding two years or to both.

Protection against suits and legal proceedings

16. No action, suit, prosecution or other proceedings shall be

brought, instituted or maintained in any court against the Minister,

any member of the Council, the Chief Statistician, any Deputy

Chief Statistician or officer of the Department of Statistics Malaysia

in respect of any act, neglect or default done or omitted by him

in the course of carrying out his duties under this Act unless

it can be proven that the act, neglect or default was done or

omitted in bad faith and without reasonable cause.

Liability of director, etc., of company, etc.

17. (1) Where any person who commits an offence under this Act

is a company, limited liability partnership, firm, society or

other body of persons, a person who at the time of the commission

of the offence was a director, compliance officer, partner,

manager, secretary or other similar officer of the company, limited

liability partnership, firm, society or other body of persons or

was purporting to act in the capacity or was in any manner or

to any extent responsible for the management of any of the affairs

of the company, limited liability partnership, firm, society or

other body of persons or was assisting in its management—

(a) may be charged severally or jointly in the same proceedings

with the company, limited liability partnership, firm,

society or other body of persons; and

(b) if the company, limited liability partnership, firm, society

or other body of persons is found guilty of the offence,

shall be deemed to be guilty of that offence and shall be

liable to the same punishment or penalty as an individual

unless, having regard to the nature of his functions

in that capacity and to all circumstances, he proves—

(i) that the offence was committed without

his knowledge; and

(ii) that the offence was committed without his

consent or connivance and that he had taken all

reasonable precautions and exercised due diligence

to prevent the commission of the offence.

Power to make regulations

18. (1) The Minister may make regulations as may be necessary

or expedient for the purpose of carrying into effect the provisions

of this Act.

(2) Without prejudice to the generality of subsection (1),

the Minister may make regulations to prescribe any fee payable

under this Act, including any processing fee.

(3) Any regulations made under this Act may prescribe any act

in contravention of the regulations to be an offence and may

prescribe penalties—

(a) of a fine not exceeding ten thousand ringgit or

imprisonment for a term not exceeding twelve months

or to both if the person is an individual; or

(b) of a fine not exceeding twenty thousand ringgit if

the person is a body corporate.
Statistics 15

Power to issue directive, circular and guidelines

19. The Chief Statistician may issue any directive, circular

or guidelines as the Chief Statistician considers necessary

or expedient for the purpose of carrying out the provisions of

this Act.

Prosecution

20. No prosecution for an offence under this Act shall be

instituted without the consent in writing of the Public Prosecutor.

Part VI

REPEAL

Repeal

21. The Statistics Act 1965 [Act 415] is repealed.

Saving

22. (1) Any notice issued under the Statistics Act 1965 shall,

on the date of coming into operation of this Act, continue to

be valid and be deemed to have been issued under this Act.

(2) Any officer and servant of the Department of Statistics who

has been appointed before the date of coming into operation of

this Act shall, on the date of coming into operation of this Act,

continue to be an officer of the Department of Statistics Malaysia

and shall be subject to the law for the time being in force relating

to the public service of the Federation.

(3) Any reference to the Department of Statistics in any written

law or document shall, upon the coming into operation of this Act,

be construed as a reference to the Department of Statistics Malaysia.
